root_idea.summary: The root denotes drinking, especially taking a liquid into the body; related meanings extend through absorption, saturation, allocation of water, and places or times of drinking.
root_idea.development: The primary sense is the well-known act of drinking. By metaphor and resemblance, the root develops meanings of something permeating or being imbibed, of a share or access to water, and of raising the neck as if preparing to drink.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Independent Quran-attested Form IV passive construction.
Independent Quran-attested noun for an allocated share of drinking water.
Independent Quran-attested verbal noun or simple noun for drinking.
Quran-attested active participle presented under its singular citation form.
Independent Quran-attested noun for a drinking place or source.

senses.definition: To drink: to take water or another liquid into the body.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the ordinary act of drinking, including drinking from a vessel and drinking a liquid in a single draught or gradually.

senses.definition: To cause something to permeate the heart as an imbibed substance; in the passive, to have the love of something infused into one's heart.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction أُشْرِبُوا فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْعِجْلَ means that the love of the calf was made to permeate their hearts; the object is understood as the love of the named thing.
Covers water and other liquids, including a drink prepared for consumption; the Quranic noun may refer to a drink generally or to a specified drink in a scene of reward or punishment.

senses.definition: An allotted share or turn of drinking water.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic water-sharing construction in which different parties have designated drinking rights or days.

senses.definition: The act or manner of drinking.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ, it characterizes the manner or intensity of drinking by comparison with thirsty camels; it is not a separate beverage noun.
The supplied Quran occurrences use the plural active participle شَارِبُونَ / شَارِبِينَ for people who drink or are drinking.

senses.definition: A place, source, or designated point of drinking.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic uses, especially the plural مَشَارِب, the word denotes a designated drinking place or source; the related lexical pattern can also denote the time or manner of drinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensive or abundant drinking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived verbal noun used when muchness of the act is intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swallow or take medicine, whether liquid or solid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional medical usage, distinct from ordinary drinking of a liquid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To inhale or smoke tobacco.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later or specialized usage in which smoke is treated as being imbibed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a crop, stalk, or ear of grain to absorb sap, nourishment, or farina and become filled or near maturity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative agricultural use based on the image of a plant imbibing liquid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To consume or devour something figuratively, including another's livestock, milk, or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical extension in which consumption is described as eating or drinking the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To charge or accuse someone of an act that he did not commit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic expression literally meaning ‘you made me drink what I did not drink.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be satisfied by drinking, or conversely to be thirsty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources record both opposite applications; the intended sense depends on context and usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed prepositional idiom, not the ordinary transitive sense ‘to drink.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: To understand or comprehend what has been conveyed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct dialectal or lexical usage, illustrated by the exhortation to listen and then understand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone drink or give someone a drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II usage with a person or other recipient as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To provide people or livestock with food and drink; figuratively, to let livestock pasture freely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feeding sense may be expressed with property or cattle as the supplied object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To water land or palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative agricultural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To imbue or soak a morsel with grease, gravy, or another liquid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is made to absorb the saturating substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat a new waterskin with clay and water so that its taste becomes agreeable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized preparation of a water container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drink with another, or to water camels together with another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III expresses reciprocal participation in drinking or watering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give camels water or cause them to drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV usage synonymous with watering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To saturate, suffuse, or intermingle one thing with another, especially a color with a material or another color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same extension is used of a sound mixed with another sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something disappear into or be swallowed up by the air.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction describing an object raised so high or quickly that it becomes barely visible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a rope or cord on the neck, or to tie camels to one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized tropical use with people, camels, or horses as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach the time appointed for watering one's camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form IV usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To absorb or imbibe something gradually; for a dye to permeate a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources specifically describe gradual absorption and also a construction in which the dye pervades the cloth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a color to become intense or deeply saturated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived intransitive color term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stretch out or raise the neck, especially to look; by extension, to raise or exalt oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The original image is of an animal extending its neck in preparation to drink; the common extended use is looking attentively or becoming exalted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of drinking, as the verbal noun of شَرِبَ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun usage distinct in vocalization from the Quranic شُرْبٌ form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People drinking or assembled for drinking; a collective or quasi-plural of شَارِبٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This plural-like use refers to a group rather than to the act itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fine species of flax.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicographical attribution recorded for this headword; its status is less secure than the drinking-related meanings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person characterized as drinking much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet in the expression أَخُوكَ شُرْبٌ, effectively ‘your brother is a heavy drinker.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water itself, or water fit to be drunk, sometimes specifically a drinkable but particular kind of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use distinct from شِرْبٌ meaning an allotted share of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A draught of milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specifically attested liquid and quantity sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The use of, or right to use, water for irrigating fields and watering animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal term concerning water rights.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A watering place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Synonymous with a place to which people or animals come for water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A time of drinking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources describe this as a tropical application and report disagreement about its connection with the primary sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act or draught of drinking, or the quantity drunk at one time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may refer to a draught of water or wine without creating a separate beverage sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dose of medicine taken by drinking or eating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional medical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree growing from a date stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun, unrelated to the ordinary quantity sense except by root association.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quantity of water sufficient to quench thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quantity-oriented noun, distinct from a single draught merely by its satisfying effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tinge or admixture of one color in another, especially redness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a complexion or other surface that contains a visible coloration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much drinking or the habit of drinking heavily.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related epithet denotes one who drinks much.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small water-filled trough or channel around a tree or an irrigated plot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object retains water for irrigating the tree or land; the same term can denote the associated irrigated portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirst, especially thirst of animals after pasture or when they come to water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A state resulting in or calling for drinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehemence of heat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is associated with the increased amount of water drunk on a very hot day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who drinks much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet for a person who eats and drinks heavily.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tangled, dense herbage growing one part above another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive noun applied to vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way, mode, or manner of being or acting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression ‘upon one consistent course or affair.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: A soft or plain tract of land producing herbs but lacking trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side of a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical usage recorded separately from the herb-producing tract sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beverage forbidden by religious law.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal and post-classical specialization of the general beverage noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Syrup.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later usage for a sweet concentrated liquid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water that is drinkable but inferior, brackish, bitter, or otherwise disagreeable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources report several distinctions concerning degrees of sweetness and whether humans or animals drink it; the common branch is imperfect drinkability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who drinks vehemently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel desirous of the stallion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who drinks, draws water, or waters camels with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or companion sense, distinct from the active participle simply meaning a drinker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cup-bearer, butler, or seller of wine or syrup.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun derived from the beverage sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A raising or stretching of the head like an animal preparing to drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun associated with اِشْرَأَبَّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Addicted to drink, especially wine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tassel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry itself marks this as probably post-classical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mustache or hair growing over the upper lip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural شَوَارِبُ may refer to the mustache or its two sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two long projections at the lower part of a sword hilt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative term based on the two long portions of mustache hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ducts or channels around the throat, windpipe, and related passages.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical plural term; authorities differ on the exact structures intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Channels through which water runs in a spring or source.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported lexical application distinct from the anatomical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an ear of grain to be permeated by farina or to have grain approaching maturity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative agricultural adjective based on imbibing nourishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weakness or feebleness in an animal, or a strain of such weakness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical noun-like use in descriptions of an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A people or party living on the bank of a river and possessing its water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun based on association with a water source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose camels have drunk to satisfaction, or whose camels or himself are thirsty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The participial form can describe either the completed watering or the resulting need for water according to context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An upper chamber, rooftop room, or roofed vestibule.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An architectural extension explained by the idea that people drink there.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Soft or plain land containing abundant green herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun distinct from the architectural sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of drinking, especially food that makes one drink much water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of the pattern denoting something that produces the associated action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A drinking vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A vessel from which one drinks, distinct from a drinking place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A complexion tinged or intermixed with redness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of a color suffused with another color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A complexion strongly tinged or intermixed with redness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intensified Form II passive participle marks a pronounced admixture of color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A technical class of letters whose pronunciation in pause includes a blowing quality without the full stress of the voiced-letter class.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A phonetic term for the letters ز، ظ، ذ، ض, with reported variation in the authorities.

cautions: The occurrence at 36:73 is contextually glossed as “drinks,” but the directly supported lexical discussion of مَشْرَبٌ securely establishes a place, source, or point of drinking; the packet does not independently establish a separate beverage sense for that occurrence.
The sheep-or-goat meaning under شَرِيبَةٌ is retained as unresolved evidence because the source explicitly suggests that the headword may instead be سَرِيبَةٌ.

Several Classical entries report competing nuances for water quality, thirst, and time of drinking; those distinctions are preserved without treating every reported variant as a separate Quranic sense.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:$rb:38208:g1:main materially describes a sheep or goat driven back from water, but the entry's own marginal correction says the intended word may be سَرِيبَةٌ, so the meaning is not confidently assigned to شَرِيبَةٌ.

The contextual rendering of مَشَارِبُ at 36:73 as “drinks” is not independently resolved by the supplied lexical evidence; the public Quranic sense therefore uses the securely attested drinking-place/source branch and does not invent a separate beverage sense.
